completeBackupOnExit: Complete a full backup on exit
recommendedBackupRetentionCount: Recommended number of backups to keep
allowDuplicateSnapshotCleanup: Allow previewing and removing automatic snapshots with identical content
backupScheduleAndRetentionNotice: Scheduled intervals are checked only while the app is running. Old backups and history are not deleted automatically; when the recommended count is exceeded, you can preview them before cleanup. All version history is kept by default.
projectStorageFormatsNotice: Manuscript text uses TXT / Markdown, settings use YAML / JSON, and images retain their original files. SQLite stores only rebuildable indexes.
lightweightBackupMissingImagesNotice: Lightweight backup (excludes images; original images may be missing after restoration)
novelBackupScopeNotice: Backups coordinate writes by the app and check whether external files have changed. They include this book’s task history, chapter reading positions, bookmarks, literature reading positions, interface layout, and personal preferences; private records from other novels are excluded.
importIntoCurrentChapterHistory: Selectively import into the current novel’s chapter history
overwriteProjectSafetyBackupNotice: Only matching project IDs are supported. A full safety backup is required and will be created before the operation.
restorePersonalWritingSettings: Also restore the theme, fonts, and personal writing settings (project reading and editing positions are restored with the work)
referenceLibraryBackupScopeNotice: Library backups use the same data center directory and verification mechanism, and include original files, notes, analyses, style profiles, and references. Select a scope in the literature library or style reference library to back up, restore, and rebuild indexes.
wholeBookExportNotice: Export the whole book’s final manuscripts in chapter-number order; unconfirmed revisions are excluded.
manuscriptImportRevisionNotice: UTF-8 TXT / Markdown is saved as a separate revision for the selected chapter number. Existing files are kept.
manuscriptImportedAsSeparateRevision: Manuscript text imported as a separate revision
settingsImportFormatNotice: Accepts YAML / JSON containing a single setting entity or a list of entities. Imported as research drafts; create templates for custom categories first.
novelSearchContentHint: Characters, settings, chapter titles, images, and tags
chineseSearchMatchingNotice: Chinese text uses substring matching. The index is refreshed from open-format files before searching.
recycleRestoreProtectionNotice: Final manuscripts and committed chapters are protected. Restoration stops if a file with the same name exists; files are never silently overwritten.
filesPendingRecycling: Files to move to the recycle bin
selectEditableContentHint: Select editable manuscript text, a character, or a setting
entityRecyclingProtectionNotice: Entities and images can be moved to the recycle bin from their respective detail views. Committed characters and referenced settings are protected.
storageCleanupPreviewScopeNotice: Preview thumbnails and temporary image files older than 7 days. If history deduplication is enabled, only automatic snapshots with an existing identical copy are listed; unique history, named checkpoints, and original files are kept.
cacheCleanupCompletedNotice: Cache cleared. Original images remain intact.
confirmSelectedCacheCleanup: Confirm cleanup of these cache files
